metadata.title: CrowdStrike and Palo Alto AI Winners Ahead of Earnings

content.text:
This article first appeared on GuruFocus.
Wells Fargo Said CrowdStrike (CRWD) and Palo Alto Networks (NASDAQ:PANW) are seeing solid enterprise spending on cybersecurity products ahead of their upcoming earnings reports.
Wells Fargo said channel partners were 31% above plan on a net basis, while weighted growth reached 16% year over year, up from 13% in the prior quarter. More than half of respondents expect growth to accelerate during the second half.
Wells Fargo maintained Overweight ratings and price targets of $230 for CrowdStrike and $475 for Palo Alto. The survey also recorded seven Palo Alto deals above $10 million during the quarter.
Wells Fargo said channel partners were 31% above plan on a net basis, while weighted growth reached 16% year over year, up from 13% in the prior quarter. More than half of respondents expect growth to accelerate during the second half.
Artificial intelligence was the leading growth catalyst, followed by identity, endpoint, data and exposure security. Respondents also indicated that about 40% of AI-related security budgets are coming from spending pools outside traditional security allocations.
Palo Alto ranked first in expected spending consolidation and share gains across SASE and security operations. CrowdStrike, meanwhile, had multiple deals above $10 million, including several exceeding $20 million, with activity spanning cloud, SIEM, identity and XDR.
